t: This is Belgrave Road, a long street in Pimlico, in the City of Westminster. It runs from Eccleston Bridge in the northwest down to Lupus Street in the southeast. The Reverend Mackenzie Walcott died on this road in 1880. He was an English clergyman, and he is known as an ecclesiologist and an antiquarian, which means he studied church history, buildings and old records. Pimlico's rows of stuccoed terraces were home to many such quiet, learned figures.
